name: wheelmachine
description: Make, fork and run Wheelmachine machines, open their apps and work with your repositories, from your agent: Wheelmachine's MCP server and skills for its tools.

interface.longDescription: Wheelmachine is computers in the cloud for people and their agents. This plugin gives your agent Wheelmachine's MCP server and skills, to make, fork and run machines, open their apps, see and work their desktops, and work with your repositories. It is for people who want their agent to build, test and run things away from their own computer. It needs a Wheelmachine account: you sign in through your browser, or set the server up yourself with an API key. A command may run for up to 10 minutes, and a machine's desktop is Linux.
defaultPrompt: Make a Wheelmachine machine, run uname -a in it, then delete it.
Make a machine, clone my repository in it, run its tests and tell me what failed.
Fork my machine, try the upgrade on the fork, and keep the original as it was.
